description: Find deprecated and removed APIs in this project's code for the exact versions it runs (from the lockfiles): e.g. `app.mount` deprecated in hono 4.13, with the replacement and where it is used (file:line). Only package names and versions are sent to CodexGuild; the code is searched locally and never uploaded. codexguild_sync runs this automatically.

cwd.description: Project directory (defaults to the current directory)

name: codexguild_scan_code
